newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada's Churchill port to open Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Canada's Churchill port to open Tuesday.

text.p: Canada's northernmost grain port of Churchill opens its 1997 shipping season Tuesday when the MV Theotoko is scheduled to dock, the port's manager said.
The Greek ship should load 31,000 tonnes of grain for an undisclosed destination, port manager Ray Robusky said.
The Canadian Wheat Board wouldn't say where the cargo was headed.

Churchill's port, on the western shore of Hudson's Bay, loaded 305,000 tonnes of wheat and barley on a dozen ships bound for Mexico, Brazil and Egypt in the 88 days it was open to vessels August 3 to October 28, 1996.
Churchill needs to load 600,000 tonnes to break even.
